It compared phrasing for 2 positions. 2 positions have eligible source findings and 0 have a specific scope limit. 1 scope decisions and 1 eligible source comparisons remain open. The report’s source rows list the individual endnote numbers and gap findings.

rows.source: Publication attribution and edition
rows.usage: Supplied PDF cover and imprint, PDF pp. 1–2. Bibliographic comparison.
rows.finding: The supplied PDF front matter names Alex Stone and identifies China Aerospace Studies Institute as publisher. Edition or release date is recorded as February 7, 2022.
evidence: China’s Model of Science: Rationale, Players, Issues (GovInfo PDF)

rows.source: Substantive argument and evidentiary scope
rows.usage: Supplied PDF pp. 7–11. Extracted argument in paraphrase.
rows.finding: Stone compares the organization of science and its policy rationales, distinguishing historical institutional development from metrics of performance. The quadrant framing helps discuss how basic inquiry and practical use can coexist. Applying it to an entire system remains an interpretive choice. This reading establishes the scope of the authors’ argument. Its interpretation and broader empirical inferences need case-specific primary evidence.
evidence: China’s Model of Science: Rationale, Players, Issues (GovInfo PDF)

rows.source: Donald E. Stokes, Pasteur’s Quadrant: Basic Science and Technological Innovation
rows.usage: PDF p. 2 credit and p. 89, note 248. Publisher description compared with the report’s credited framework.
rows.finding: The publisher identifies Stokes’s framework and its distinction between the goals of understanding and use. This supports the idea that basic inquiry can also be use-inspired. Stone’s application of that framework to institutions is an interpretation. The cited pages 73–75 were not independently compared with the publisher summary.
evidence: Donald E. Stokes, Pasteur’s Quadrant: Basic Science and Technological Innovation

rows.source: Numeric target for the science contribution indicator
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 28. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report says the 2006 plan sought a 60 percent contribution of S&T progress to economic growth. Related printed notes 99 on PDF p. 79.
rows.finding: The plan sets a target above 60 percent. This is a different statistical quantity from R&D spending as a share of GDP. The 2020 expenditure bulletin measures inputs and cannot be used to determine whether the contribution estimate reached its target.
evidence: State Council medium- and long-term S&T plan for 2006–2020, full text preserved by a university
NBS, MOST and Ministry of Finance final national S&T expenditure bulletin for 2020

rows.source: Original Science and Technology Progress Law enactment date
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 19. Extracted claim in paraphrase. China codified S&T progress policy in a law enacted in 1993. Related printed notes 46 on PDF p. 76.
rows.finding: The ministry’s annotated legal text identifies July 2, 1993 as the original NPC Standing Committee adoption date. Its displayed text is the later revision. Use the chronology in the heading for the original date.
evidence: MOST annotated text of the Science and Technology Progress Law

rows.source: Original technology commercialization law date
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 19. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The dedicated technology-transfer law was passed in 1996. Related printed notes 47 on PDF p. 76.
rows.finding: The original legal archive records adoption on May 15 and effect on October 1, 1996. The ministry archive’s later web publishing date refers to the online copy.
evidence: MOST archive of the original 1996 technology-transfer law

rows.source: What the 2015 commercialization law changed
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 19. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report describes technology-transfer protections before 2015 as minimal. Related printed notes 47 on PDF p. 76.
rows.finding: The original law already had a technical rights chapter and inventor rewards. The 2015 revision changes authority over use, disposal and proceeds and adds stronger incentives. The law comparison confirms expansion. The qualitative judgment about how effective earlier protections were requires implementation evidence.
evidence: MOST archive of the original 1996 technology-transfer law
MOST archive of the 2015 technology-transfer law revision

rows.source: Party leadership in Double First-Class evaluation criteria
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 21. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The trial evaluation factors include political and institutional leadership. Related printed notes 55 on PDF p. 76.
rows.finding: Article 2 expressly confirms Party leadership as an overarching requirement and the evaluation provisions include governance and leadership. The rules also consider teaching and original research. The document does not disclose the weights used in individual assessments.
evidence: Joint ministry trial evaluation rules for Double First-Class, 2021

rows.source: First long-range science plan’s name and horizon
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 24. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The 1956–1967 instrument was the PRC’s first long-range science and technology plan. Related printed notes 69 on PDF p. 77.
rows.finding: The national statistical agency’s historical retrospective calls it the first long-range plan and dates its preparation to 1956. The span covers twelve calendar years inclusive.
evidence: National Bureau of Statistics historical retrospective on the 1956–1967 science plan

rows.source: Task counts and research topics in the 1956 plan
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 24. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The final design distinguished 616 topics from 57 broad research undertakings. Related printed notes 70 on PDF p. 77.
rows.finding: The NBS retrospective gives 57 major tasks. The Jiusan Society history separately records 616 central topics under 57 major tasks. Preserve the nesting because the 616 and 57 figures refer to different levels of the same plan.
evidence: National Bureau of Statistics historical retrospective on the 1956–1967 science plan
Jiusan Society institutional history of the 1956 plan

rows.source: Reported early completion of 50 plan projects
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 24. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report repeats a retrospective estimate that 50 of 57 projects were completed early. Related printed notes 74 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: The historical records corroborate the 57-task denominator and describe selected outcomes. They supply no project-level table of dates, so they do not verify whether 50 were completed ahead of schedule. The cited historical article and the completion criteria are needed.
evidence: National Bureau of Statistics historical retrospective on the 1956–1967 science plan
Jiusan Society institutional history of the 1956 plan

rows.source: Dates of the 2006–2020 science plan
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 25. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The plan covers 2006 through 2020. Related printed notes 79 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: The title of the archived State Council instrument explicitly gives 2006–2020. Note 79’s English label starts in 2005 while its Chinese title gives 2006. Use the official title and distinguish plan period from preparation or notice dates.
evidence: State Council medium- and long-term S&T plan for 2006–2020, full text preserved by a university

rows.source: 2050 science-power horizon in the 2006 plan
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 25. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report separates the 2020 innovation objective from an ambition for the middle of the century. Related printed notes 79 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: The State Council plan sets out becoming an innovative country by 2020 and a mid-century ambition to become a world S&T power. This supports the interpretation of 2050 as an approximate planning horizon, not a fixed delivery date.
evidence: State Council medium- and long-term S&T plan for 2006–2020, full text preserved by a university

rows.source: Final 2020 R&D intensity against the national target
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 28. Extracted claim in paraphrase. Stone gives a preliminary 2.4 percent figure against a 2.5 percent target. Related printed notes 99 on PDF p. 79.
rows.finding: The final joint bulletin also reports 2.40 percent of GDP. The plan’s target is above 2.5 percent. The preliminary and final total yuan estimates differ, while the rounded intensity is unchanged. The target was missed by at least about 0.1 percentage point.
evidence: State Council medium- and long-term S&T plan for 2006–2020, full text preserved by a university
NBS, MOST and Ministry of Finance final national S&T expenditure bulletin for 2020

rows.source: Denominator in the external technology dependence target
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 28. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The study discusses a target expressed in relation to a 30 percent technology-dependence threshold. Related printed notes 101 on PDF p. 79.
rows.finding: The plan calls for external technological dependence to fall below 30 percent by 2020. That is a target level rather than a 30 percent proportional cut. A compatible baseline and series would be required to estimate the reduction achieved.
evidence: State Council medium- and long-term S&T plan for 2006–2020, full text preserved by a university

rows.source: Size and structure of the 2015 reform programme
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 30. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The reform plan is divided into ten areas, 32 measures and 143 implementation items. Related printed notes 117 on PDF p. 80.
rows.finding: The issued text and ministry summary differentiate the ten policy areas, 32 reform measures and 143 policy points or outputs. The numbers describe programme design. They are separate from counts of completed reforms.
evidence: Published 2015 science and technology reform implementation plan
MOST archive with official explanation of the 2015 plan’s measures

rows.source: Evidence for completion of all 143 reform items
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 31. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report attributes a claim of complete implementation to a ministry official. Related printed notes 118 on PDF p. 80.
rows.finding: The implementation plan and ministry summary confirm the number of items. Neither of these records publishes a completed item-level checklist. The attributed statement is useful evidence of the ministry’s position and requires an outcome review for independent confirmation.
evidence: Published 2015 science and technology reform implementation plan
MOST archive with official explanation of the 2015 plan’s measures

rows.source: 2018 replacement of the science and education leading group
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 34. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The State Council turned its science and education group into a science and technology leading group. Related printed notes 127 on PDF p. 81.
rows.finding: The official notice is signed July 28 and posted August 8, 2018. It explicitly adjusts the predecessor group into the new body. Both dates are needed to reconcile references using the issue date or online publication.
evidence: State Council General Office notice for the 2018 National S&T Leading Small Group

rows.source: Scope of the 2018 group’s formal mandate
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 34. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report describes the leading group as responsible for major decisions in S&T. Related printed notes 127, 128 on PDF p. 81.
rows.finding: The notice enumerates review of strategies, plans, policies and projects and coordination across departments and localities. This confirms a significant coordinating and deliberative role. It does not rank all Party and state bodies or confer final authority for every S&T decision.
evidence: State Council General Office notice for the 2018 National S&T Leading Small Group

rows.source: Initial membership and location of group secretariat
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 34. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The original group was led by Li Keqiang and Liu He. Related printed notes 127 on PDF p. 81.
rows.finding: The dated notice names Li as head and Liu as deputy. It assigns the office to MOST and names the then science minister as office director. Apply these roles to the notice’s date only.
evidence: State Council General Office notice for the 2018 National S&T Leading Small Group

rows.source: Statutory use of scientific advisers
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 34. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The revised S&T Progress Law prescribed making use of scientific and technical experts in policy decisions. Related printed notes 131 on PDF p. 81.
rows.finding: The 2007 revision’s provisions on consultation call for expert views in major science and technology decisions. This corroborates the general requirement. It does not independently identify the later advisory committee or its membership.
evidence: MOST annotated text of the Science and Technology Progress Law

rows.source: Public and higher education share of basic research
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 50. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The study’s three displayed expenditure figures imply about 96 percent of basic research by higher education and public institutions.
rows.finding: The report’s 72.22, 51.03 and 5.08 billion yuan amounts total 128.33 billion, and the first two make up 96.04 percent of that subtotal. The statistics bulletin defines performer sectors and separately reports the national aggregate. A complete 2019 cross-tabulation is needed to establish that the subtotal equals all basic research.
evidence: NBS, MOST and Ministry of Finance final national S&T expenditure bulletin for 2020

rows.source: Patent metric is annual domestic grants
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 52. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The plan sought a top-five ranking for inventions granted to nationals.
rows.finding: The plan specifies annual invention patent grants to nationals. It also has a separate citation-count indicator for scientific publications. Patent-office totals including foreign applicants should not be substituted for the nationality-based indicator.
evidence: State Council medium- and long-term S&T plan for 2006–2020, full text preserved by a university

rows.source: Scale and composition of the planning consultation in 1956
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 24. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report describes participation by more than 600 scientists and about 100 Soviet experts in drawing up the plan. Related printed notes 69, 70 on PDF p. 77.
rows.finding: The institutional sources corroborate extensive domestic and Soviet consultation. A participant list or a primary account defining counted scientists and advisers is needed for both precise counts.
evidence: Sun Lie on early PRC research institutions and mobility
State Council archive of the retrospective on seven science plans

rows.source: Period of the national 1978–1985 science plan
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 25. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report identifies a post-Cultural Revolution eight-year science plan. Related printed notes 78 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: The official S&T plan retrospective identifies the 1978–1985 planning horizon and describes its place in the policy chronology. It is distinct from later research programmes under the same period.
evidence: State Council archive of the retrospective on seven science plans

rows.source: Revision of the earlier science planning horizon in the 1990s
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 25. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The table distinguishes the 1986–2000 plan from a 1991–2000 revision. Related printed notes 78 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: The official retrospective treats the later ten-year plan together with the Eighth Five-Year Plan and distinguishes it from the earlier plan. This explains overlap in years in the table.
evidence: State Council archive of the retrospective on seven science plans

rows.source: Status of the follow-on plan extending to 2035
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 25. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The authors report an intended subsequent long-term science plan then being prepared. Related printed notes 76 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: The national Fourteenth Five-Year Plan sets economy-wide 2035 objectives. A separate released long-term science plan would be needed to confirm the specific ninth instrument anticipated in the study.

rows.source: Start year of the national Gongguan programme
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 26. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The paper dates the national programme for tackling key problems to 1982. Related printed notes 83 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: MOST’s retrospective specifically gives 1982 as the implementation start, under the early reform-era national planning framework.
evidence: Archived official retrospective on the national Gongguan programme
State Council archive of the retrospective on seven science plans

rows.source: Cumulative spending and projects in the Gongguan programme
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 26. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report gives combined investment and project counts for 1982 to 2000. Related printed notes 83 on PDF p. 78.
rows.finding: The ministry programme retrospective identifies 379 hundred-million yuan and 534 projects for the period. Converting the source units yields the study’s 37.9 billion yuan.
evidence: Archived official retrospective on the national Gongguan programme

rows.source: Relative share implied by 700 of 3,000 reported institutes
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 48. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report characterises approximately 700 of more than 3,000 institutes as around 20 percent. Related printed notes 187 on PDF p. 85.
rows.finding: At the lower-bound denominator of 3,000 the computed share is about 23 percent. The actual yearbook denominator and rounding convention are required to test the reported approximate share.
evidence: National Bureau of Statistics 2019 R&D expenditure communiqué

rows.source: Magnitude of historical enterprise R&D spending growth
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 50. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The study contrasts its historical enterprise spending baseline with the 2019 level.
rows.finding: The official 2019 result confirms the final nominal spending amount. The report’s 1995 estimate needs the specific historical definition and release to ensure consistent performer coverage and comparability.
evidence: National Bureau of Statistics 2019 R&D expenditure communiqué
World Bank R&D expenditure series and measurement guide

rows.source: Start of Qian Xuesen’s study at MIT
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 17. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The study uses Qian’s study abroad to illustrate the pre-PRC training of Chinese scientists and engineers.
rows.finding: Caltech’s institutional biography places the start of Qian’s MIT studies in 1935 and his subsequent transfer to Caltech later. These are historical education milestones.
evidence: Caltech institutional biography of Qian Xuesen

rows.source: Date and setting of the Science Society’s founding
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 17. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report attributes the society’s formation to Cornell students in January 1914. Related printed notes 27 on PDF p. 75.
rows.finding: Harvard’s archival description confirms the Cornell origin in 1914 and distinguishes the later formal society name. The month needs a contemporary organisational record. Published histories distinguish several founding milestones.
evidence: Harvard archival finding aid for Science Society of China papers
Max Planck Research Library original historical study of Cornell and Kexue

rows.source: Place of publication of the first Kexue volume
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 17. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report dates the society’s journal to 1915 and says it was published in Shanghai. Related printed notes 27 on PDF p. 75.
rows.finding: The archival description confirms the society began publishing Kexue in China in 1915. The historical study places the first issue in January and identifies the journal as the society’s principal publication.
evidence: Harvard archival finding aid for Science Society of China papers
Max Planck Research Library original historical study of Cornell and Kexue

rows.source: Online and issue dates of Nature’s funding debate editorial
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 21. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The study cites Nature’s Diversionary Tactics with a 1 July 2005 date. Related printed notes 52 on PDF p. 76.
rows.finding: The publisher dates online publication to 13 July 2005 and the issue to 14 July. The editorial’s record supports the controversy attribution. Its public preview gives limited detail on the underlying distribution claim.
evidence: Nature original Diversionary Tactics editorial record

rows.source: Access limit for the ministry obstruction allegation
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 21. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report relays an allegation of obstruction of the Nature supplement. Related printed notes 52 on PDF p. 76.
rows.finding: Nature’s public abstract confirms a dispute over the supplement. Full access to the editorial and available distributor or publisher records are needed to establish the precise action and the actors involved.
evidence: Nature original Diversionary Tactics editorial record

rows.source: Policy basis for the proposed specialised high-end think tank network
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 36. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The study places the planned 50–100 specialised think tanks in a central policy effort. Related printed notes 138 on PDF p. 82.
rows.finding: The 2015 central opinion specifies the approximate target and intended institutional and policy scope. Treat it as a programme target at adoption.
evidence: 2015 central opinion on Chinese think tanks

rows.source: Date and scope of reported pilot think tank roster
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 36. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report gives 29 institutions in the national high-end pilot group as of December 2020. Related printed notes 139 on PDF p. 82.
rows.finding: The governing policy establishes selection criteria and the Development Research Center describes an earlier phase. A December 2020 official roster is still needed to validate the cumulative count.
evidence: 2015 central opinion on Chinese think tanks
State Council Development Research Center account of the pilot group

rows.source: Reference window and output unit for the 2021 research map
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 37. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The study describes 10,223 areas and 97 clusters from highly cited literature over 2012–2017. Related printed notes 141, 142 on PDF p. 82.
rows.finding: CAS confirms the mapping research programme and researcher role. The later edition is insufficient for the exact 2021 input and output counts. The 2021 release and its methods appendix are needed for a numerical match.
evidence: CAS Science Strategy Institute Research Structure Mapping report
CAS biography of research map author Wang Xiaomei

rows.source: Government and market roles in the national innovation system
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 45. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The paper locates the innovation system formulation in the 2006 long-term science plan. Related printed notes 168 on PDF p. 84.
rows.finding: The adopted outline describes a government-guided system drawing on market resource allocation and collaboration. It establishes the stated organising model.
evidence: 2006 State Council national science and technology outline

rows.source: Enterprise-led subsystem within the 2006 science plan
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 45. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The paper identifies an enterprise-led technological innovation subsystem. Related printed notes 169 on PDF p. 84.
rows.finding: The plan gives enterprises the main role in the technology innovation system and calls for partnerships with universities and research institutes. That is one part of a larger programme.
evidence: 2006 State Council national science and technology outline

rows.source: 2020 horizon for establishing the innovation system
rows.usage: Supplied PDF p. 46. Extracted claim in paraphrase. The report describes 2020 as the policy horizon and assesses the system as a work in progress. Related printed notes 174 on PDF p. 84.

rows.usage: Supplied PDF pp. 6–8. Extracted argument in paraphrase.
rows.finding: Hull and Markov organize the history into periods and distinguish policy relationship, acquisition and research cooperation. Their method combines documentary accounts whose visibility differs across time and institutions. An agreement or public display supports a dated observation, while causal claims about industrial change require stronger attribution. This reading establishes the scope of the authors’ argument. CASI-B15-02.followup_detail: CASI PDF p. 49 places Yue Xicui’s birth in Tai’an in December 1948. A government-hosted personnel table gives December 1948 and lists Tai’an in its ancestral-home column. The 2007 PLA Daily profile describes her as from Tai’an and born in 1948. The current Baidu entry cited by the note distinguishes Tai’an origin from birth in Boshan, Zibo. The birthplace remains unresolved pending the August 2003 Air Force News pages or the 2009 interview.

CASI-B15-05.followup_detail: The note describes an interview with PLA officials. The supplied record has no transcript or identifying publication.
The note cites an interview on 4 December 2018. A transcript is unavailable. The same interview is cited by CASI-B15-11 note 73.

The PLA Daily interview reproduced by People's Daily on 17 April 2013 confirms Guan Youfei’s role and the substance of his remarks on CASI PDF p. 335. The English block combines the end of one answer with the next answer’s discussion of disclosure, including the press spokesperson, website and invitations to foreign journalists. Attribute the statement to Guan in the April 2013 interview about The Diversified Employment of China’s Armed Forces. The Chinese text confirms the attribution and substance. The original English republication was unavailable for verbatim comparison.
